description: Track food, training, groceries and time with guided setup and reviews.

defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Orendro and personalize it for what I want to track.
Show my day in Orendro and help me fill in anything I missed.
Help me set up daily check-ins and optional receipt reminders with Orendro.
interface.longDescription: Orendro helps you organize personal tracking and planning in your connected account. Log food and completed workouts, manage groceries and time entries, and review saved records. Guided setup lets you choose what to track and save optional preferences. Basic food logging does not require body measurements or nutrition targets. Orendro respects the connection's permissions and asks for confirmation before destructive actions. Recurring check-ins depend on the scheduling and notification capabilities available in your chosen assistant; drafting a routine does not activate it. Only the connected account's authorized records are available.
